title: Union giving in the years its labor agreements passed
question: Did a union family give more in the years the Board adopted its labor agreements, and the year before, than in other years since 2015?
finding: Carpenters: $291,000 a year around its agreements (2024), $63,046 in other years; Deputy Sheriffs’ Association: $161,044 a year around its agreements (2017, 2019, 2024), $39,622 in other years; IFPTE Local 21: $230,441 a year around its agreements (2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2024, 2026), $59,510 in other years; Municipal Executives’ Association: $2,868 a year around its agreements (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2026), $2,500 in other years. 4 of 13 families gave more around agreement years, 9 gave less.
how: Agreement years are the passage years of the ordinances in the previous table, matched to a union family by the name in the title; giving per year is the “unions” results (2015 to 2026). 'Around' means the passage year and the year before.
limits: Labor agreements and elections both fall in even-numbered cycles, so a mayoral or supervisor race in the same year explains most of any rise; the giving is disclosed. Timing is a question, not proof of an exchange; the Board adopts agreements that the Department of Human Resources negotiates or an arbitrator awards.

sources.t: San Francisco Board of Supervisors: legislation records with titles, status, dates and action history (Legistar; each row links to its file)
